image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a modern steam iron. The body is primarily white with deep blue accents on the handle and upper casing. A translucent green water tank is visible near the front. The soleplate appears metallic but is partially obscured by shadow and angle. A power cord extends from the rear right. There is some text/branding on the side, though it is blurry.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the lower white body is illegible and smudged, resembling AI-generated pseudo-text rather than crisp manufacturing logos.
The green plastic lacks realistic refraction or internal detail; it looks like a flat, semi-transparent green overlay rather than a physical container holding water.
The boundary between the metal soleplate and the white plastic body is slightly soft and indistinct in the mid-section, lacking the sharp mechanical seam expected in real hardware.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as an iron and not a similar appliance (e.g., steamer).
To assess the overall realism, lighting consistency, and detect subtle texture artifacts in the plastic and metal.
To rigorously analyze the illegible text on the side for character-level coherence vs. gibberish.
To verify the physical connectivity and sharpness of the edge between the metal plate and plastic housing.

focus_areas: Legibility and structure of side text/logos
Realism of the translucent green water tank (refraction/transparency)
Sharpness of the seam between soleplate and body
Consistency of specular highlights on metal vs. plastic
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'text_gibberish' artifact. AI often fails at rendering small product logos. Also, evaluate if the green tank looks physically plausible or like a 'floating' color layer. Check if the soleplate reflection matches the environment lighting.
